date_note: Date is the day of the Tax Committee's statement as reported by Nuz.uz; the page gives no earlier day for the alleged leak.
exec: Uzbekistan's Tax Committee says the circulating online cash register data did not come from its systems and points to one operator's infrastructure; the leak itself is unconfirmed.
geo_basis: country stated by the source (Uzbekistan's Tax Committee); no city given
plain: Posts on social media and Telegram claimed online cash register data had leaked. The Tax Committee says its own systems were not breached and the incident concerns one register operator's infrastructure.
summary: Social media posts and Telegram channels claimed that data from Uzbekistan's online cash register system had leaked. The Tax Committee says the information was not stolen from its systems and that its check found no signs of unauthorized access; it says the incident is tied to the infrastructure of one online cash register operator, which it did not name. It is checking that operator's compliance with security requirements.
title: Uzbekistan's Tax Committee denies its systems were the source of claimed online cash register data leak

validation.note: Single publisher (Nuz.uz) relaying the Tax Committee's statement; the leak claim itself is unconfirmed and the committee's own page was not read. Nuz.uz says the operator was not named and the scope of exposed data is unclear.

review.note: Compared Tax Committee statement, unnamed operator, claimed status against Nuz.uz
